column1: Single source of truth for every summary in this workbook. One row per lease case. Position as at 31-Jul-2026. Billed to Date, GST in Billed & Future Demand reconciled from Zoho Books customer-wise rental (EMI) invoices dated up to 31-Jul-2026 (down-payment invoices excluded; DP shown in col O). GST = 18% component within billed (gross, GST-inclusive). Future Demand = EMI x Tenure - Billed; set to 0 for REPO / FORE CLOSE. Updated 19-Aug-2026.
